ideas.title: Grow a Comet ☄️
ideas.hook: Your plot floats in orbit. Feed a tiny ice seed until it becomes a comet, then launch it at planets for cash.
core_loop: Plant a comet seed on your orbit plot
Feed it ice and dust so it grows a longer tail
Launch it at a planet in the sky
Earn cash by impact size and tail length
Buy rarer seeds and bigger launch pads
ideas.twist: Comets keep growing while you are offline, but too big and they break loose and crash into a neighbour's plot, giving them the loot.
monetization: Luck pass for rare comet mutations
retention: New planets to target each update
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm is the top rising mechanic at 1.96 (up 0.60 this week, 55 new games, 124,504 CCU) led by [🐜] Ant Evolution (31,456) and Throw a Seed (17,219). Space is the top rising theme at 2.50 with [🛸] Sweep The Moon 🌕 (7,540).
ideas.differentiator: Farm games harvest and sell; here the crop is the projectile, so growing and launching are one loop.

ideas.title: +1 Mech Plating 🤖
ideas.hook: You are a small robot. Every punch you land bolts +1 armour plate onto your body, until you are a walking tank.
core_loop: Punch scrap dummies
Each hit adds +1 plating
Bigger plating unlocks heavier zones
Fight other mechs in the ring
Rebirth for a stronger frame
ideas.twist: Plates are visible and can be knocked off in PvP, so you see exactly who is strong and can strip a rival bare.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action is rising at 1.84 (43 new games) and the "+1 ___" title formula sits at 1.90, led by [🌍UPD 5] +1 Venom Evolution (10,285) and +1 Boxing Battle Evolution (7,179). +1 stat × Robots / mechs is the second biggest gap in the data (score 4.71), and Robots / mechs is rising at 1.86.
ideas.differentiator: The stat is physical armour on your body that rivals can knock off, not just a number.

ideas.title: Paint Bots for Battle 🎨
ideas.hook: Paint a blank robot. Whatever colour you paint where decides its power: red arms punch harder, blue legs run faster.
core_loop: Get a blank bot
Paint its parts with colour powers
Send it into the arena against other players' bots
Win paint cans and rare colours
Unlock bigger bot frames
ideas.twist: Paint wears off where your bot gets hit, so you repaint between rounds and copy colours that worked against you.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is rising at 1.66 (33 new games, 48,031 CCU) with Ragdoll Wars! (6,171) and [🦖T-REX] BoneBox Engine 🩸 (4,534). Paint / create × Robots / mechs is a top-3 gap (score 4.25) and Robots / mechs is up 0.28 this week to 1.86, led by Mechs vs Kaiju's Ragdoll | [DRILL UPDATE].
ideas.differentiator: Painting is the build system and the stats at once, so every bot looks different and you can read its strengths at a glance.

ideas.title: Go AWOL 🪖
ideas.hook: You are a recruit stuck on a strict army base. Sneak through barracks, vents and the motor pool to escape before roll call.
core_loop: Pick a squad of 1-4 players
Sneak past patrols and searchlights
Find keycards, uniforms and tools
Escape by truck, tunnel or parachute
Unlock new bases and escape routes
ideas.twist: Every escape route is a different job: dig with a spoon, steal a jeep, or fake a transfer form, and guards learn your last route.
ideas.why_now: Escape / run holds at 1.40 (40 new games, 93,783 CCU) with 13 Days to Escape [ALPHA] (10,941), and Military / war is up 0.36 this week to 1.63 with Voxel Wars (15,467). Escape × Military is a gap (score 3.95), and Interiors / corridors is the top rising map style at 1.80.
ideas.differentiator: Military games are about fighting; here you are the one running from the army, with stealth instead of guns.

ideas.title: Grow a Hedge Fort 🧟
ideas.hook: Zombies come every night. Plant thorny hedges by day and they grow into living walls that hold the horde back.
core_loop: Plant hedge seeds around your plot
Water and trim them into walls
Survive the night wave
Collect zombie drops for rare seeds
Grow taller, spikier forts
ideas.twist: Hedges keep growing and need trimming: overgrown walls block your own exits, but wild growth also traps more zombies for loot.
monetization: Luck pass for rare thorn seeds
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm is the fastest rising mechanic at 1.96 (up 0.60 this week) with [2x WEEKEND] Farm Evolution (10,102) and [🐜] Ant Evolution (31,456). Grow × Zombies is an open gap (score 3.60), and Tycoon / base building stays above trend at 1.26 with 106 new games.
ideas.differentiator: Your crops are your defence, so farming and base building are the same action.

ideas.title: Drill Derby ⛏️
ideas.hook: Race drill cars straight through a block mountain. The tunnel you dig is the track, and ore you hit on the way is your cash.
core_loop: Pick a drill car
Race down through a voxel mountain
Grab ore and avoid lava pockets
Finish first for a bonus
Upgrade drill bits, engines and armour
ideas.twist: Players can cut across each other's tunnels to cave them in, so every race digs a new map.
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig is up 0.33 this week to 1.48 with Sandworm Playground (10,990) and Flat the Mountain (9,684), and Break × Race / drive is one of the strongest pairs (5 new games, 70,181 CCU). Voxel / blocky is the top rising art style at 2.32.
ideas.differentiator: Mining games dig alone and racing games drive on fixed tracks; here the race builds the track.

ideas.title: Spin Cars for Cash 🌀
ideas.hook: Grab a car by the bumper, spin like a hammer thrower and let go. The farther it flies, the more cash.
core_loop: Pick up a car
Spin to build speed
Release and launch it
Earn cash by distance and crashes
Unlock heavier cars and bigger arenas
ideas.twist: Heavier cars pay more but need more spins, and letting go late sends them flying backwards into the crowd for a bonus.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch × Race / drive is the top pair in the data (7 new games, 94,376 CCU). Hit / swing is at 1.55 with Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (63,684) and Throw a Seed (17,219), and Vehicles is up 0.27 this week to 1.29. The "___ for ___" title formula is at 1.37.
ideas.differentiator: Launch games throw items or ragdolls; here the cars themselves are the projectile, with crash physics as the payoff.

ideas.title: Moon Buggy Shootout 🌕
ideas.hook: Low-gravity buggy battles on the moon. Drive, jump craters and shoot rivals out of the arena.
core_loop: Pick a buggy and a turret
Join a round on a moon arena
Boost off craters and shoot rivals
Collect moon rocks for upgrades
Unlock new moons and weapons
ideas.twist: Low gravity means every hit knocks buggies into the air, so ramps and knockback matter more than raw damage.
ideas.why_now: Race / drive × Shooter is a top pair (6 new games, 87,413 CCU), Shooter is up 0.42 this week to 1.38 with [🏹] Shoot Arrows For Animals! (18,865), and Space is the top rising theme at 2.50 with [🛸] Sweep The Moon 🌕. Arena maps are rising at 1.39.
ideas.differentiator: Car shooters are on flat ground; moon gravity turns every fight into a mid-air knockback duel.

ideas.title: Ice Paint Wars ❄️
ideas.hook: Paint the floor with ice or fire. Your team slides fast on your colour, and rivals slip and burn on theirs.
core_loop: Join a team in a round
Spray ice or fire paint on the floor
Slide on your colour, trip rivals on yours
Most floor covered wins
Unlock new sprayers and maps
ideas.twist: Ice and fire cancel out, so you can melt the other team's paint and turn it into steam that blocks the view.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is rising at 1.66 (33 new games) and Paint × Ice / fire / elements is a gap (score 3.45). Ice / fire is up 0.14 this week to 1.13 with Pumpkin Playground (6,146), and Lobby + round maps are at 1.11.
ideas.differentiator: Paint party games score area only; here your paint changes how everyone moves.

ideas.title: Grow a Tank 🪖
ideas.hook: Plant a tiny toy tank in your garden. Water it and it grows into a real tank you can drive into battle.
core_loop: Plant tank seeds
Water and fertilise them to grow bigger
Harvest a tank and drive it
Battle other players' gardens
Spend loot on rarer seeds
ideas.twist: Harvest early for a fast small tank or wait for a giant one, but rivals can raid your garden while it is still growing.
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm leads rising mechanics at 1.96 and Fight / battle × Grow / farm is a live pair (7 new games, 43,976 CCU). Military / war is up 0.36 this week to 1.63 with Voxel Wars (15,467) and Ragdoll Wars! (6,171), and Fight / battle is up 0.37 to 1.17.
ideas.differentiator: Military games hand you a tank; here you grow it, so the garden is your armoury and your weak spot.
